tools.name: deep_search
tools.description: Retrieve the top documents for `query` and have the local reading assistant read their full text for `goal`. Returns the assistant's report and the docids it read.

goal.description: The specific thing you want confirmed or extracted from the documents

tools.name: read_for
tools.description: Have the local reading assistant read the full text of documents you already found (by docid) for `goal`. Returns the assistant's report.

goal.description: The specific thing you want confirmed or extracted from the documents

docids.description: Document ids, for example from search results
